def load(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def write(path: str | Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

    Path(path).write_bytes(canonical_json(value))

    return value

    if value.get("amendment_sha256", expected) != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"{amendment} receipt hash mismatch")
    return value
